title: Satisfied clauses in the linear equation encoding
statement: Let $V$ be a set, let a constraint specify a right-hand side in $\mathbb F_2$ and an ordered triple of distinct variables from $V$, and let $a:V\to\{0,1\}$ be any Boolean assignment. Form the four three-literal clauses associated with that linear constraint. The number of those clauses satisfied by $a$ is three plus the indicator that the corresponding equation, that the sum of the three assigned values equals the specified right-hand side in $\mathbb F_2$, is satisfied.
hypotheses_covered: V is a type of variables
constraint is an E3Lin constraint with three distinct variables and a right-hand side in 𝔽₂
assignment maps every variable in V to a Boolean value
